svg.aria-label: Simulated outer-race bearing fault. The raw waveform and raw spectrum are dominated by shaft rotation and a 3 kHz resonance, with no clear line at the 90 Hz defect frequency. After band-pass filtering around the resonance and demodulating, the envelope spectrum shows clear peaks at 90, 180 and 270 Hz.
svg.text: shaft rotation and noise hide the small periodic impacts
energy at shaft speed and a broad resonance near 3 kHz
demodulating the band reveals the impact rate · BPFO = 90 Hz for 9 balls on a 25 Hz shaft
